run_image_regression_training: run image regression training by passing a training_config JSON file path via the --training_config argument
train_image_regression_model: train an image regression model using HuggingFace Transformers with a config dict or ImageRegressionParams object
parse_training_config_args: parse command line arguments to extract the training_config JSON file path for image regression training
push_model_to_hub: push a trained image regression model to the HuggingFace Hub using the HfApi after training completes
create_model_card: create a model card README for the trained image regression model using utils.create_model_card
